verdict.rationale: Crossplane says its declarative APIs are "machine-readable" and lets you define schemas for composite resources through Composite Resource Definitions. Because it builds on the Kubernetes control plane, the APIs are schema-defined, but the evidence never documents a downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OpenAPI/spec format and how to download or export it, any spec for Crossplane's own APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
